label: ercot221 arm adaptive
definition: ercot-221 arm: adaptive-expectation storage offer (two-pass P1, model settled-price events per Amendment 4, half-life 30d beta 3.0077 — PRECOMMIT-ercot221 + Amendments 1-4; owner-instructed Phase-1 over the recorded Phase-0 screen-fail)
market_story: Storage: ERCOT batteries in 2023 priced scarce SOC at their experienced recent frequency of deep-scarcity events — the IMM's artificial-shortage summer monetized through adaptive expectation offers ($3.4-5k asks after August's spike experience, decaying to ~$300 by November as events vanished). The mechanism reproduces that conduct from the model's OWN price path (7/3/0 self-generated spike days across 2023/24/25; the 2025 floor is exactly zero — self-extinguishing), with two measured-conduct constants (30 d memory half-life, gain 3.0077) identified on the 2023 daily evening SCED offer surface and frozen. No measured price, no year key, no regime parameter enters the armed path.
